meta.title: Driftwood Coffee · Austin | Your third place on the east side
meta.description: A neighborhood coffee shop in East Austin. Single-origin roasts, real mugs, room to stay.

labels.demo_note: This is a fictional demo cafe.

hero.headline:
Your third place
on the east side.
hero.lede: Single-origin beans roasted weekly, mugs you can hold with two hands, and nobody rushing you off the table by the window.

why.title: A coffee shop that remembers you.
why.sub: Chains optimize for lines. We optimize for the second visit — your order, your seat, your name.

cards.title: Roasted this week
cards.desc: We roast small batches every Monday. The bag on the shelf is never older than seven days.

cards.title: Stay as long as you like
cards.desc: Real mugs, wide tables, outlets at every seat. Laptop hours until 3pm, human hours after.

cards.title: A back room for your people
cards.desc: Book clubs, team offsites, birthday pour-overs — a 16-seat room you can reserve free with any catering order.

pricing.title: Three ways to make it a habit.

items: Three single-origins, brewed side by side

items.quote: They had my order ready when I walked in on visit three. It's the only place I actually feel like a regular.
items.name: Aaron D.

items.quote: Booked the back room for our book club every month. They set up the pour-over bar for us without asking.
items.name: Carmen S.

items.quote: The subscription ruined grocery store coffee for me forever. Worth it.
items.name: Tom W.
